sources.title: README.md · Alibaba-DAMO-Academy/ClinFusion-8B at main
sources.snippet: ClinFusion-8B is the highly efficient, lightweight version of the ClinFusion multimodal large language model series. Built upon the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct base, ClinFusion-8B integrates a composition and cascaded vision encoder framework (featuring DINOv2 and ConvNeXt) to deliver state-of-the-art medical and clinical understanding.
